entries.summary: Created new vanilla JS frontend (frontend-v2) with zero dependencies. Minimal memory usage, API-based, hash routing.
entries.details: Built frontend-v2 from scratch using pure HTML/CSS/JS. Features: hash-based routing, localStorage token management, responsive design, dark mode support. Views: home, login, register, courses, course-detail, lesson, settings with GitHub connection.
entries.code:
// Structure:
frontend-v2/
├── index.html
├── css/style.css
├── js/
│   ├── app.js (router setup)
│   ├── store.js (state management)
│   ├── api.js (HTTP client)
│   ├── router.js (hash routing)
│   ├── utils.js (helpers)
│   └── views/
│       ├── home.js
│       ├── login.js
│       ├── register.js
│       ├── courses.js
│       ├── course-detail.js
│       ├── lesson.js
│       └── settings.js

// Running on port 5175
